echoParts: let your light shine before others
so that they may see your good works
and give glory to your Father
verseText: In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father who is in heaven.
meaning: Jesus tells us to live in a way that shines God's goodness to others like a light in the darkness. When others see God's children obeying their Father in heaven, they will give glory to him.
